32403-human-error.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. el, had been talking with Ed Harris on the _Griseda_. As a matter of routine, all their conversation was taped, and some of this was recovered from the crash and played back at the investigation.

arxiv-2306-07388.title: Clocked dynamics in artificial spin ice
arxiv-2306-07388.creator: Johannes H. Jensen, Anders Strømberg, Ida Breivik, Arthur Penty, Miguel Angel Niño, Muhammad Waqas Khaliq, Michael Foerster, Gunnar Tufte, Erik Folven
arxiv-2306-07388.description: Abstract Artificial spin ice (ASI) are nanomagnetic metamaterials exhibiting a wide range of emergent properties, which have recently shown promise for neuromorphic computing. However, the lack of efficient protocols to control the state evolution of these metamaterials has been limiting progress.

arxiv-2308-12533.title: Pre-trained Model-based Automated Software Vulnerability Repair: How Far are We?
arxiv-2308-12533.creator: Quanjun Zhang, Chunrong Fang, Bowen Yu, Weisong Sun, Tongke Zhang, Zhenyu Chen
arxiv-2308-12533.description: Abstract Various approaches are proposed to help under-resourced security researchers to detect and analyze software vulnerabilities. It is still incredibly time-consuming and labor-intensive for security researchers to fix such reported vulnerabilities due to the increasing size and complexity of modern software systems.

arxiv-2405-07429.title: JointLoc: A Real-time Visual Localization Framework for Planetary UAVs Based on Joint Relative and Absolute Pose Estimation
arxiv-2405-07429.creator: Xubo Luo, Xue Wan, Yixing Gao, Yaolin Tian, Wei Zhang, Leizheng Shu
arxiv-2405-07429.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xubo Luo, Xue Wan, Yixing Gao, Yaolin Tian, Wei Zhang, Leizheng Shu. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) visual localization in planetary aims to estimate the absolute pose of the UAV in the world coordinate system through satellite maps and images captured by on-board cameras. However, since planetary scenes often lack significant landmarks and there are modal differences between satellite maps and UAV images, the accuracy and real-time performance of UAV positioning will be reduced.

arxiv-2502-13116.title: New gravitational wave probe of vector dark matter
arxiv-2502-13116.description: Abstract The longitudinal components of massive vector fields generated during inflation constitute a well-motivated dark matter candidate, with interesting phenomenological implications. During the epoch of radiation domination following inflation, their spectrum exhibits a peak at small scales, whose amplitude and position are governed by the parameters of the dark matter model.

arxiv-2601-18764.title: A general variational approach for equilibrium phase boundaries of trapped spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensates
arxiv-2601-18764.creator: Sahil Satapathy, Projjwal K. Kanjilal, A. Bhattacharyay
arxiv-2601-18764.description: Abstract We develop a simple and general variational method to estimate the solutions of the Gross-Pitaevskii equations and obtain the corresponding density profiles for all spin states of a trapped spin-1 Bose-Einstein condensate. We further employ this approach to obtain the complete phase diagram of the system under quasi-one-dimensional harmonic confinement, with ferromagnetic or antiferromagnetic spin interactions.

pmc-10675434.title: Long-Term Bovine Colostrum Supplementation in Football Players
pmc-10675434.creator: Mirosława Cieślicka, Błażej Stankiewicz, Radosław Muszkieta, Małgorzata Tafil-Klawe, Jacek Klawe, Anna Skarpańska-Stejnborn, Joanna Ostapiuk-Karolczuk, David C Nieman, Giannis Arnaoutis
pmc-10675434.description: Physical exercise, especially of high intensity, is a significant burden on an athlete’s body. It should be emphasized that achieving high results in competitive sports requires the use of significant, sometimes extreme, exercise loads during training, which may result in homeostasis disorders, adversely affecting the fitness of athletes.

pmc-11425106.title: Impact of sustainable energy, fossil fuels and green finance on ecosystem: Evidence from China
pmc-11425106.creator: ZuoTeng Wang, Sheng Zeng, Zohan Khan
pmc-11425106.description: The adoption of sustainable energy has increased as a substitute for petroleum derivatives due to growing concerns about environmental degradation caused by pollution and non-renewable energy sources. This study aims to investigate the impact of sustainable energy, green finance, and fossil fuels on the ecology of China.

pmc-12446959.title: The relationship between mother/father phubbing and non-suicidal self-injury in adolescents: a moderated mediation model of rumination and school connectedness
pmc-12446959.creator: Dali Lu, Zaihua Qing, Chuhan Yan, Shijiao Tang, Chenxi Lin, Xiaoqun Liu
pmc-12446959.description: BackgroundParental phubbing has been shown to be associated with adolescents’ self-harm. However, the differential effects of mother/father phubbing on adolescents’ NSSI have been overlooked, and much less is known about the mechanisms underlying this relationship.ObjectiveThe present study explored the relationship between father phubbing (Fphubbing) and mother phubbing (Mphubbing) and adolescents’ NSSI.

pmc-12968952.title: Complications of Laser and Energy‐Based Procedures in Dermatology: Classification, Management, and Prevention
pmc-12968952.creator: Lynhda Nguyen, Wolfgang Kimmig, Stefan Hammes, Stefan W Schneider, Nikolaus Seeber
pmc-12968952.description: SummaryLaser and energy‐based devices (EBDs) are firmly established in dermatology and widely used for both medical and aesthetic purposes. Even with advanced safety features such as integrated cooling and real‐time monitoring, these procedures still carry inherent risks. Complications may occur as a result of inappropriate device choice, suboptimal parameter settings, insufficient patient evaluation, or limited operator experience.

pmc-13114235.title: Low-Temperature Sintering Inks for Printed Bioelectronics: Materials, Mechanisms, and Emerging Ideas
pmc-13114235.creator: Abhijit Bera, Fei Liu, Matthew R. Marander, Ricardo Ortega, Ahmad Mustafa Ahmad Malkawi, Utsav Kumar Dey, Ritinder Sandhu, Tyler P. Collins, Shan Jiang
pmc-13114235.description: Printed electronics have emerged as a versatile manufacturing platform for next-generation biosensors, enabling on-demand and low-cost fabrication of functional devices on flexible, stretchable, and unconventional substrates. One major challenge in this field lies in the sintering of printed features, as conventional high-temperature processing is incompatible with polymeric substrates and thermally sensitive biological components.

pmc-13401924.title: Association of Busulfan Exposure with Event-Free Survival in a Chinese Pediatric Cohort: A Multicenter, Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-13401924.creator: Chenrong Huang, Xiaohuan Du, Ling Xue, Lin Song, Xiaoxue Liu, Zhiyao Chen, Xiaoling Wang, Maoquan Qin, Ximu Sun, Dao Wang, Jing Yang, Dongjun Li, Hua Jiang, Wenjiao Ding, Yuhua Qu, Zengyan Zhu, Libo Zhao, Jinjie Yuan, Ji Dong, Depei Wu, Shaoyan Hu, Liyan Miao
pmc-13401924.description: PurposeTherapeutic drug monitoring-based individualized busulfan (Bu) administration improves hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) outcomes, but optimal Bu exposure in Chinese pediatric patients remains unclear; we aim to identify the optimal exposure level of Bu in such patients receiving Bu-based conditioning regimens of different intensities.

pmc-13423973.title: Potential Solar Precursors to Magnetic Switchbacks
pmc-13423973.creator: Durgesh Tripathi, Maria S Madjarska, Judy Karpen, Marco Velli, Clara Froment, Etienne Pariat, Spiros Patsourakos, Nour E Raouafi, Alexis P Rouillard, Alphonse C Sterling, Kostas Tziotziou, Peter F Wyper
pmc-13423973.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The origin of magnetic switchbacks—large-amplitude, spherically polarized magnetic-field fluctuations with local polarity inversions shown to be nearly ubiquitous in the inner heliosphere by Parker Solar Probe—is presently one of the most outstanding open questions in solar and heliospheric science. The occurrence of these structures in the young solar wind is a topic of active research, focusing not only on their characteristics and evolution but also on unraveling the puzzle of their origin.

pmc-13571829.title: Comparative Perspectives on Obesity From Medical Students, Practitioners, and Non-medical Students
pmc-13571829.creator: Sophia Rafiq, Zainab Pervaiz, Taleah Khan, Abdullah Ahmad, Amna Nadeem
pmc-13571829.description: Objective: Obesity is a multifactorial chronic disease with a rising prevalence globally and in Pakistan. Despite this, public understanding and acceptance of obesity as a disease remain inconsistent, often contributing to stigma and delayed care. Examining how different groups perceive obesity is essential for guiding public health efforts and reducing weight-related stigma.

pmc-13637189.title: Nomogram for predicting 6-month BMIZ changes in children with Crohn’s disease: a single-center retrospective study
pmc-13637189.creator: Yifei Zhang, Peilin Wu, Xilin Peng, Bihong Ma, Yueli Lin, Xiaowei Zheng, Suqing Chen
pmc-13637189.description: BackgroundPerianal disease (PD) is an aggressive phenotype in children with Crohn’s disease (CD), but its measurable impact on short-term nutritional recovery remains understudied. This study aimed to evaluate the independent effect of PD on the 6-month Body Mass Index Z-score (BMIZ) trajectory and to develop a practical nomogram for early risk stratification in pediatric CD.

pmc-13650164.title: Osteoporosis screening and management framework for community-based primary care in Hong Kong: A Delphi consensus study
pmc-13650164.creator: Ching-Lung Cheung, Hing-Sun Chan, Pak-Kin Chan, Alvina Wing-Sze Chau, Cindy Ming-Wah Choi, Dicky Ka-Chun Chow, Dilys Yan-Wing Chow, Hoi-Yan Chung, Bonnie So-Kuen Lam, Wing-Wo Lam, Bonnie Leung, Yuen-Lok Ma, Janus Chi-Keung Wong, Sze-Hung Wong, Kenny Wai-Ming Wong, William Ho-Ching Yuen
pmc-13650164.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesOsteoporosis poses a significant public health challenge as it leads to an increased incidence of fractures. This can result in considerable disability and substantial financial burdens. With the rapidly aging population in Hong Kong, the incidence and impact of osteoporotic fractures are expected to rise, underscoring the need for a coordinated, community-based care model to identify at-risk older adults and offer timely management.MethodsThis study adopted a Delphi methodology to develop consensus statements and a structured framework for community osteoporosis screening and management
